query:
select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='user_activity_events'
 and column_name='read_at' and data_type='timestamp with time zone' and is_nullable='YES') as event_read_column_ok,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('index',c.relname,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)))
 from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid=i.indexrelid where c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace
 and c.relname in ('activity_inbox_page_idx','activity_inbox_unread_idx','delivery_inbox_copy_idx')) as inbox_indexes,
 not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.user_activity_events','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') as event_direct_writes_denied,
 not has_table_privilege('anon','public.user_activity_events','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') as anon_event_direct_writes_denied,
 not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.notification_deliveries','INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') as delivery_direct_writes_still_denied
